question: Should OpenClaw make 16 MiB the unconditional maximum size for existing Comfy `workflowPath` files?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically focused, but selecting a new fixed rejection threshold changes a persisted user configuration path and cannot be resolved from the patch alone.

options.title: Accept the 16 MiB limit
options.body: Treat workflow files above 16 MiB as unsupported and merge the bounded reader with a documented upgrade expectation.

options.title: Preserve larger existing workflows
options.body: Keep the bounded-read objective but choose an owner-approved limit or policy that does not silently invalidate known valid configurations.

recommendation.title: Preserve larger existing workflows
recommendation.body: Keep the bounded-read objective but choose an owner-approved limit or policy that does not silently invalidate known valid configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: The only evidence-backed routing candidate available from the supplied review context is the author of the current Comfy implementation; current-main ownership history needs confirmation before merge.
